name: travel_emergency
title: Travel Emergency
description: Handling common travel emergencies including lost items, missed connections, and minor medical issues.
common_interactions: Reporting a lost passport or wallet
Asking for help with a missed flight or train
Describing a minor injury to a passerby or medic
learner_goals: State that there is an emergency
Explain what was lost or stolen
Ask for the nearest hospital or police station
Inquire about the next available flight or train
